user_prompt: Show top 5 customers by total order spend in 2024
verified_sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5;
explanation: Joins users and orders, filters for completed transactions within calendar year 2024, groups by user ID and orders descending.

user_prompt: Calculate total revenue generated per product category in 2024
verified_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS total_orders FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 50;
explanation: Calculates revenue by multiplying line item quantities by unit prices, grouped by category for completed orders in 2024.

user_prompt: Find completed orders from the last 7 days with customer names and total amount
verified_sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, u.name AS customer_name, u.email, o.total_amount, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50;
explanation: Retrieves completed orders within the trailing 7 days joined with customer names, ordered chronologically.
